title: Copilot Studio: persistent identity (agent accounts) for agents
summary: Hold: the table says agent blocking has no documented API, but Microsoft publishes a preview Graph endpoint for that action. The statement that no tenant-level controls restrict agent actions beyond the account switch and blocking also overlooks documented data policies. The roadmap dates, activation paths, preview licensing and shared-memory warnings are supported.

claims.claim: The general agent-blocking action is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > select an agent > Block.
claims.quote:
Select Agents > All agents.

claims.claim: The general agent-blocking control has no documented API or automation equivalent.
claims.quote:
Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block
claims.fix: Set controls[2].api to kind graph, call 'POST /beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block', and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/package/copilotpackage-block. State that this is a preview API, requires Microsoft Agent 365 licensing and delegated CopilotPackages.ReadWrite.All, and is not supported for production applications. Retain the row's general-control applicability caveat.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: An agent with an account retains one shared memory across the people it works with.
claims.quote: The agent keeps one memory across everyone it works with, so what one person explains benefits the whole team.

claims.claim: Shared memory has no privacy boundary between users.
claims.quote: The agent is guided not to bring up one person's details with someone else, but shared memory has no privacy boundary between users.

claims.claim: The People card warns that shared files and chats can be summarised in responses to people without source permissions, regardless of sensitivity label.
claims.quote: Any files or chats you share can be summarized and included in the agent's responses to any user, even users without permissions to the files or chats and regardless of sensitivity label.

claims.claim: Shared memories are automatically deleted after 28 days without anyone interacting with the agent.
claims.quote: If no one interacts with the agent for 28 days, the system automatically deletes its shared memories.

claims.claim: End users cannot opt out of shared memory in this preview.
claims.quote: No. End users can't opt out of shared memory in this preview. By using the agent, you consent to its use of shared memory.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no tenant-level control limiting agent-account actions beyond the Agent accounts switch and agent blocking.
claims.quote:
Policies with a tenant scope apply to all agents in all environments across the tenant.
To prevent agent makers from using Power Platform connectors as tools in Copilot Studio agents, configure a data policy with the connectors you want to block.
claims.fix: Remove the broad absence claim. Replace it with: 'Tenant-scoped Copilot Studio data policies can restrict connector tools and supported capabilities; this is not a universal per-account action allow-list.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention and describe only its documented scope. The already-cited govern-agents-identities-overview also states that advanced connector policies and data policies govern connector calls at execution time.

claims.claim: The agent-account feature page does not publish its general-availability licensing.
